_comment: Delphi generic config schema (architecture-agnostic). Copy this file and replace values.
_comment_top_level: Required top-level keys: name, seed, data, model, optimizer, trainer, extra.
_comment_gui: GUI always passes -c <config>. Optional CLI overrides from GUI: --data --epochs --batch-size --device --resume-checkpoint.
_comment_paths: data.path can point anywhere (absolute path recommended when datasets live outside Delphi).
name: my_experiment

data._comment: Dataset/DataLoader settings consumed by your DataLoader factory.
data._comment_required: Required conventions: batch_size > 0, train_split in (0,1), path points to your dataset root/file.

model._comment: All keys here are forwarded to model __init__ as kwargs (works for DNN, CNN, Transformer, etc.).
model._comment_required: Only include constructor kwargs expected by your model class.

trainer._comment_required: Required conventions: epochs > 0, device in {auto,cpu,cuda...}, save_dir is writable.

inference._comment: Optional epoch-end inference telemetry for the GUI Inference tab.
inference._comment_required: Set every_epochs to 0 to disable, or a positive integer (e.g., 5) to run every N epochs.

extra._comment_project_folder: Preferred: set project_folder to models/<ProjectName> to resolve train.py, infer.py, and local trainer_factory.py.
extra._comment_project_name: If set, GUI resolves scripts as models/<project_name>/train.py and models/<project_name>/infer.py.
extra._comment_entrypoints: Optional explicit override paths from Delphi root: train_entrypoint, infer_entrypoint.
extra._comment_factory: trainer_factory_path controls the actual model/data/loss wiring used by train/inference.
extra._comment_factory_contract: Optional: extra.factory is a validated contract consumed by project factories.

components._comment: Optional component-driven wiring (used when extra.trainer_factory_path = core/component_factory.py).
components._comment_refs: You can reference values via $section.key, e.g. $loss.label_smoothing.
